features.description: Show the two sites, local training node, gate and staged release as one moving loop
Show read-only Expanso Cloud job status without lifecycle controls
Open a retained conversation with assistant, teacher and approved target
Open a training round with held-out before and after answers
Approve, edit, discard and batch-review pending corrections
Compare current and candidate scores on the fixed held-out set
Show North then South activation receipts and rollback state
Page collect, teacher, review, train, gate and rollout with real input and output
Run and inspect North site collection
Run and inspect South site collection
Run and inspect the recorded local teacher
Run and inspect the bounded training trigger
Run and inspect staged adapter rollout
Start in light mode and provide an explicit dark toggle

browser_assertions.description: Left and Right page the explorer without moving its scroll anchor
Both copy controls report local success and forced failure
Visible text meets WCAG AA in light and dark
The page has no horizontal overflow at 320, 400, 768 and 1440 pixels
Explorer input and output are valid pretty-printed JSON
The live topology moves before pipelines start, including reduced motion
